name: 2371-prefillheavy-dsv2coderfp8-tp8
model: RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8. Ungated, but ~237 GB and NOT in the local HF cache: it downloads once before the first start.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 236B total / 21B active, 60 layers, hidden 5120, MLA attention, vocab 102400, FP8 with a static activation scheme.
workload: synthetic_text, 1 turn, 512 prompt tokens and 8 output tokens exactly, 256 streams, no shared prefix
purpose: A 236B code assistant on eight GPUs triaging 512-token snippets with eight-token verdicts for 256 concurrent users.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Nothing here is tuned. Anything not listed is left at this
# release's default.

# ~237 GB, ungated, NOT in the local HF cache -- one download before the first start.
model-path: RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8

# DeepseekV2Config is remote code on the Hub; without this the config will not load at all.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

quantization: fp8
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e5m2

mem-fraction-static: 0.7
max-running-requests: 4096

# The engine halves the second to 8192 under data-parallel attention, so a prompt-processing
# batch is sixteen of these 512-token prompts and no prompt is ever split across chunks.
max-prefill-tokens: 16384
chunked-prefill-size: 16384

# Load-bearing for the workload: the prompts share no prefix by construction, so with the
# radix tree off all 8192 requests pay their full 512 tokens.
disable-radix-cache: true
